name: resolve_search_center
description: Resolve a Travis County city, alias or ZIP to a centroid. Call it first when a question names a place; never pass coordinates it did not return or the user did not type.

q.description: City name, alias or ZIP; normalized (casefolded, punctuation and spaces removed).

name: search_properties
description: Properties within a radius by roof age, open roofing permits and owner signals. `open_permits` is required: a property matches when its roof is older than `roof_age_min` **or**, if `open_permits` is true, it has an open or stalled roofing permit.

lat.description: WGS84 latitude; give together with lon. Omit both for a county-wide search.

lon.description: WGS84 longitude; give together with lat.

roof_age_min.description: Strict: matches roof_age_years > roof_age_min. 0 omits the age clause.

open_permits.description: Required, no default: also match properties with an open or stalled roofing permit.

long_open_years.description: Long-open threshold in years (open_duration_days >= long_open_years x 365).

owner_tenure_min.description: Years since the deed date; narrows the match.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response; tied to deploy_id and open_duration_as_of (stale_cursor otherwise).

area_note.description: For example "outside Travis County"; null otherwise.

name: search_businesses
description: Look up official Texas business records (Comptroller franchise-tax and sales-tax rows, SOS veteran-owned rows) by name or printed number. Each row is the official record of its own taxpayer, served from the source and not published by CID; a name hit is not a verified identity of a permit contractor or an owner.

q.description: Business name, at most 200 characters; normalized with the matcher normalizer. Exactly one of q or number.

match.description: exact: normalized name equals q; prefix: starts with q.
